items.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Completes $1.75 Billion Composite Units Offering
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE:DUK) has completed a US$1.75b Composite Units Offering, adding several new co-lead underwriters to the transaction. The financing move focuses on raising capital that could affect Duke Energy's balance sheet, funding plans and financial flexibility. The expanded syndicate of co-lead underwriters points to broad market participation in the offering. This kind of capital markets activity is not unique to Duke Energy. items.title: New Study Reveals Strongest State Economies, Only 1 State Was Better Than Texas
items.summary: CNBC's 20th annual state business rankings handed the overall crown to Ohio for the first time ever, but in the critical economy sub-category it was a two-state race: North Carolina led the nation and Texas came in second, even as the Lone Star State carries more foreign investment than any other top-10 economy in the country.

items.title: America's $4 Billion Wind Retreat Is a Bet on Permanently Cheap Gas
items.summary: Natural gas is a valuable source of dispatchable power, but it already supplies roughly 41% of U.S. electricity. Deliberately increasing that dependence leaves consumers and industry more exposed to fuel-price volatility.
